description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B/CORE is hiring a Junior Software Developer to support customer missions by developing and maintaining secure software systems. The role works with a multidisciplinary team to translate business problems into software solutions, uphold development standards, and build scalable, maintainable products.
Junior Software Developer writing security-compliant code and supporting software system design, testing, integration, and sustainment

Responsibilities:
• Learn to translate business problems into software solutions under the guidance of senior developers
• Write code solutions that adhere to customer security and requirements
• Supporting the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of software systems in collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team
• Ensure compliance with software design, development, testing, integration, and sustainment standards
• Research technology solutions and assist in resolving issues based on customer and business requirements
• Ensure that products are designed and developed for scalability, robustness, maintainability, and interoperability
• Learn and apply Development Best Practices through mentorship and training
• Collaborate with team members and seek ways to grow technical skills
• Participate actively in code reviews and team learning activities

Requirements:
• 0-2+ years of experience with full-stack software development leveraging one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, Groovy, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Java, Node)
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (additional experience may be substituted for education)
• Strong understanding of database foundations (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.)
• Basic understanding of relational database design principles (e.g. Normalization vs Denormalization)
• General knowledge of database administration concepts (e.g. users, schemas, constraints)
• Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience working with multimedia streaming technologies and video processing workflows (encoding, transcoding, clipping)
• Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience with API design and implementation
• Experience working in a fast-paced agile environment

Preferred:
• Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience working with Content Management Systems such as CrafterCMS
• Preferred candidates present an understanding and some experience working with a Model-View-Controller (MVC) architectural design pattern
• Experience working with Java for backend development is ideal
• Experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript for frontend development is deal
• Experience with Cloud Providers, preferably AWS
